game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Library Tower, the royal library tower: the town guard must handle rogue knights while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Variable Crates: Drag collected torches into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the town gate.
theme: The Kingdom – Library Tower: the royal library tower
core_gameplay_loop: In Library Tower, repeat each round: Drag collected torches into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the town gate. Each round, rogue knights strike the town gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the crate_b value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the town gate from rogue knights in Library Tower: keep the crate_b meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 51-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: crate_b drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 51-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 8 (extended tier): Variable Crates
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Variable Crates' (Week 1 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Library Tower'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how crate_b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue knights in Library Tower.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 51 seconds while crate_b > 0.
